REAL DOG ✦ EVERYDAY ADVENTURES ✦ BIG LIFE LESSONS
Meet the heart of the series

Four paws.
So much to teach us.

Cooper is a real dog with a playful spirit. His everyday adventures are the inspiration behind The Adventures of Cooper, a children’s story-driven coloring book series about growing through life’s little moments.

Through a game of catch, a shared adventure, or another chance to try, Cooper brings persistence, patience, joy, and friendship to life.

Cooper teaches by doing.
Children discover by joining in.

01

Keep trying.

Persistence begins with giving it another go, one little chase at a time.

02

Take your time.

Patience makes room for the next turn, the next try, and the next possibility.

03

Find the joy.

A ball. A game. Time together. Ordinary moments can hold extraordinary happiness.

04

Grow together.

Friendship turns play into connection, and little adventures into shared memories.

A few helpful details

Before the first chase.

Is Cooper a real dog?

Yes! Cooper is a real dog whose everyday play and adventures inspire the series and its themes of persistence, patience, joy, friendship, and growth.

Is this a storybook or a coloring book?

It brings both together: a story-driven coloring book that invites children to enjoy Cooper’s adventure and add their own creativity.

Where can I buy Book 1?

Find Let’s Play Ball! on Amazon for current purchase options, pricing, and availability.

Are the future adventures available?

Not yet. The ideas above are a look at possible directions for the series. No release dates have been announced.
